title: Isomorphic Labs announces Series C investment round

quotes.text: November 17, 2026
quotes.for: Publication date of the Isomorphic Labs announcement.

quotes.text: Isomorphic Labs announces it has raised $5 Billion in Series C funding. The round was co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital, alongside Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and several other new investors, with continued significant investment from Alphabet.
quotes.for: The $5 billion Series C round, co-leads, Andreessen Horowitz and Alphabet.

quotes.text: The round also included participation from all existing investors: Thrive Capital, MGX, GV, CapitalG, Temasek and the UK Sovereign AI Fund.
quotes.for: Participation from all existing investors.

quotes.text: The company is scaling its proprietary drug design engine (IsoDDE) and therapeutic candidate pipeline designed with AI to deliver the next generation of medicines for patients.
quotes.for: Scaling IsoDDE and the AI-designed therapeutic pipeline.

title: Isomorphic Labs announces $5 Billion Series C funding

quotes.text: LONDON, 17 November, 2026
quotes.for: Dateline of the Isomorphic Labs Series C news release.

quotes.text: Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital co-lead the oversubscribed round as Isomorphic Labs continues to advance its foundational simulation models, progress and scale its internal and partnered medicine candidate pipeline, and build its global AI-led bioengineering infrastructure.
quotes.for: Oversubscribed round, simulation models, pipeline scaling and bioengineering infrastructure.

quotes.text: This momentum is yielding positive preclinical results, both for internal programs in oncology and immunology and with partners, setting the stage for clinical entry.
quotes.for: Positive preclinical results in oncology and immunology and partner work.

quotes.text: Proceeds will also support the company’s continued build of scalable AI-first translational and clinical development infrastructure as it advances its drug candidates to clinical trials.
quotes.for: Use of proceeds for translational and clinical development infrastructure.

quotes.text: Isomorphic Labs is headquartered in London and has office locations in Cambridge, Massachusetts and Lausanne, Switzerland.
quotes.for: Headquarters and office locations.

quotes.text: Isomorphic Labs is led by CEO Sir Demis Hassabis and President Max Jaderberg.
quotes.for: Leadership by Hassabis and Jaderberg.

quotes.text: Every week we are making repeatable scientific advancements enabled by our models
quotes.for: Max Jaderberg on repeatable weekly advancements.

quotes.text: routinely solving complex biological problems that have stalled traditional research for decades.
quotes.for: Max Jaderberg on solving complex biological problems.

quotes.text: The breadth and precision of the simulation models within IsoDDE push predictions towards experimental accuracy and provide a suite of capabilities to advance innovative medicines.
quotes.for: Simulation models pushing predictions toward experimental accuracy.

quotes.text: Combined with powerful proprietary agents that navigate and reason over highly complex biological systems, these models directly and repeatedly translate into advancements
quotes.for: Proprietary agents navigating and reasoning over complex biological systems.

quotes.text: This round enables us to accelerate our progress: building foundational biology models, deepening our systemic disease understanding, and driving our first therapeutic programs towards clinical trials to deliver tangible impact for patients.
quotes.for: Demis Hassabis on building foundational biology models, deepening disease understanding, and driving first therapeutic programs toward clinical trials.

quotes.text: IsoDDE unifies a suite of foundational simulation AI models that natively work across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. IsoDDE explores vast chemical spaces
quotes.for: What IsoDDE combines and what it explores, as the company describes it.

title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials

quotes.text: Posted: 6:50 AM PST · November 17, 2026
quotes.for: Publication timestamp of the TechCrunch article.

quotes.text: The new funding, which comes on the heels of a $2.1 billion Series B round in May, will be used to continue developing its drug-design engine, as well as to foray into more types of medicine.
quotes.for: The May 2026 $2.1 billion Series B round.

quotes.text: The Series C is Isomorphic’s first fundraise since its founder and CEO, Demis Hassabis, left his position as head of DeepMind to focus on drug discovery, which also saw him moving into a chairman role at DeepMind.
quotes.for: First fundraise since Hassabis left his role as head of DeepMind to become chairman.

quotes.text: Isomorphic did not disclose its new valuation. Bloomberg reported earlier this month that the lab was looking to raise funding at a $50 billion valuation.
quotes.for: Undisclosed valuation and Bloomberg's $50 billion valuation report.

quotes.text: The lab has struck deals with pharma giants like Eli Lilly, Novartis, and Johnson & Johnson.
quotes.for: Pharmaceutical partnerships with Eli Lilly, Novartis and Johnson & Johnson.

quotes.text: Isomorphic Labs, the AI drug-discovery platform that was spun out of Google’s DeepMind in 2021, has raised $5 billion in a Series C funding round
quotes.for: Founded in 2021 as a DeepMind spinout.

quotes.text: The company, whose work builds on DeepMind’s breakthrough AlphaFold protein-folding AI model
quotes.for: Isomorphic Labs builds on AlphaFold.

quotes.text: won the Nobel Prize in chemistry for the lab’s work on AlphaFold
quotes.for: Hassabis shared the Nobel Prize in chemistry for AlphaFold.

title: Alphabet’s Isomorphic Labs raises $5B to accelerate drug discovery with AI

quotes.text: UPDATED 18:51 EST / NOVEMBER 17 2026
quotes.for: Publication timestamp of the SiliconANGLE article.

quotes.text: The Alphabet unit says that multiple pharmaceutical companies are already using IsoDDE to power drug discovery programs.
quotes.for: Multiple pharmaceutical companies already using IsoDDE.

quotes.text: Isomorphic says that IsoDDE speeds up the task of finding binding pockets. When there are no such pockets, it helps researchers develop compounds that cause a target protein to form them.
quotes.for: Finding and inducing binding pockets on target proteins.

quotes.text: The process of creating 3D protein models for FEP algorithms is itself a highly complex task. It requires scientists to freeze a target protein in a crystal and scan it using specialized X-ray equipment.
quotes.for: X-ray crystallization step required by traditional FEP methods.

quotes.text: IsoDDE skips that step of the research workflow. Furthermore, Isomorphic says that the software can generate higher-quality output than FEP algorithms.
quotes.for: IsoDDE skipping crystallization and claiming higher-quality output than FEP.

quotes.text: Our drug design engine is generating molecules with unprecedented precision and speed
quotes.for: Demis Hassabis quote on IsoDDE.

title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5bn in 'one of UK tech’s biggest funding rounds'

quotes.text: Tuesday 17 November 2026 7:07 pm
quotes.for: Publication timestamp of the City A.M. article.

quotes.text: London-based AI drug discovery firm Isomorphic Labs has raised $5bn (£3.8bn) in one of the largest funding rounds in British tech, as investors bet billions on AI transforming the pharmaceutical industry.
quotes.for: GBP conversion (£3.8 billion) and London base.

quotes.text: The investment follows reports last month that Isomorphic was seeking a valuation of up to $50bn, compared with roughly $17.5bn previously.
quotes.for: Previous valuation comparison of roughly $17.5 billion and up to $50 billion target.

quotes.text: The $5bn injection comes just six months after Isomorphic secured $2.1bn in Series B funding, bringing its total disclosed external funding to approximately $7.7bn since 2025.
quotes.for: Six-month interval since Series B and $7.7 billion total disclosed external funding since 2025.

quotes.text: AI minister Kanishka Narayan welcomed the announcement, calling it “one of the biggest Series C rounds in UK tech history”.
quotes.for: UK AI minister Kanishka Narayan reaction.

quotes.text: However, despite raising billions, Isomorphic has yet to begin testing its own drug candidates in humans.
quotes.for: No human clinical trials started yet.

quotes.text: City AM understands the company remains in late-stage preclinical development, with encouraging early results across its internal oncology and immunology programmes and partnered projects.
quotes.for: Late-stage preclinical development status.

quotes.text: Their work could fundamentally change how new medicines are discovered and accelerate the development of life-changing treatments for patients around the world
quotes.for: UK AI minister Kanishka Narayan on accelerating new medicine discovery.

quotes.text: I’m proud that the UK Government’s Sovereign AI Fund has made a follow-on investment in the company
quotes.for: Narayan on the Sovereign AI Fund follow-on investment.

quotes.text: The company has not disclosed its valuation following the latest raise.
quotes.for: No valuation disclosed after the Series C.

title: Isomorphic Labs breaks biotech VC fundraising record with $5B series C

quotes.text: November 17, 2026
quotes.for: Publication date of the BioSpace article.

quotes.text: Isomorphic Labs has clinched a whopping $5 billion in series C funding, more than doubling its own $2.1 billion series B from May
quotes.for: Clinched $5 billion Series C, more than doubling the $2.1 billion Series B from May 2026.

quotes.text: Altos Labs, another AI-focused drug discovery engine, previously held the title for biggest fundraise after its $3 billion debut in 2022.
quotes.for: Surpassing Altos Labs' previous $3 billion biotech fundraise record from 2022.

quotes.text: breaks the recent trend of investors putting their money behind more mature and de-risked assets.
quotes.for: Breaking the biotech investment trend toward more mature, de-risked assets.

withdrawn.why: This is the teaser of BioSpace’s May 13, 2026 article on the Series B, shown as a related link on the page; it is not part of the November 17 story.

quotes.text: The 2024 Nobel Laureate winner is also the co-founder of Google DeepMind and chief scientist for Alphabet.
quotes.for: Demis Hassabis as 2024 Nobel Laureate, Google DeepMind co-founder, and chief scientist for Alphabet.

quotes.text: London-based Isomorphic launched in 2021 and shared news of its first fundraise of $600 million in March 2025. To date, the company has raised at least $7.7 billion
quotes.for: March 2025 $600 million first fundraise and $7.7 billion total raised without disclosing a clinical program.

title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B series C months after $2.1B round

quotes.for: Publication timestamp of the Fierce Biotech article.

quotes.text: London-based Isomorphic emerged in 2021 as a spinoff from DeepMind, a sibling of Google that created AlphaFold to predict protein structures.
quotes.for: 2021 spinoff from DeepMind building on AlphaFold.

quotes.text: While Isomorphic has yet to provide details of the programs, it has shared evidence that IsoDDE outperforms AlphaFold 3 on a protein-ligand structure prediction benchmark and identifies novel binding sites.
quotes.for: IsoDDE outperforming AlphaFold 3 on a protein-ligand structure prediction benchmark and identifying novel binding sites.

quotes.text: Isomorphic is still working toward the acid test of showing how drug candidates generated using IsoDDE perform in humans and has yet to disclose detailed preclinical data
quotes.for: No detailed preclinical data disclosed yet as human testing remains ahead.

quotes.text: In 2024, Isomorphic disclosed alliances with Eli Lilly and Novartis with a combined value of about $3 billion, including milestones. The biotech raised $600 million in its first external funding round in 2025 and added Johnson & Johnson to its list of partners at the start of 2026.
quotes.for: 2024 Eli Lilly and Novartis alliances worth about $3 billion, $600 million round in 2025, and Johnson & Johnson partnership at the start of 2026.

quotes.text: While that vacuum leaves room for skepticism, the biotech has persuaded investors to write big checks and landed deals with leading drug developers.
quotes.for: Fierce Biotech on the lack of disclosed preclinical data.

title: Isomorphic Labs breaks biotech VC fundraising record with $5B series C

quotes.text: November 17, 2026
quotes.for: Publication date of the BioSpace article at its live URL (source 6 now returns 404).

quotes.text: Isomorphic Labs has clinched a whopping $5 billion in series C funding, more than doubling its own $2.1 billion series B from May and breaking the industry’s record for most money raised in a single round.
quotes.for: BioSpace calls the $5 billion series C the biotech industry’s largest single round.

quotes.text: Altos Labs, another AI-focused drug discovery engine, previously held the title for biggest fundraise after its $3 billion debut in 2022.
quotes.for: How BioSpace describes Altos Labs, and the $3 billion record it held since 2022.

quotes.text: Isomorphic has yet to publicly disclose any assets but said it has produced preclinical results for internal programs in both oncology and immunology.
quotes.for: No disclosed drug candidate.

quotes.text: The 2024 Nobel Laureate winner is also the co-founder of Google DeepMind and chief scientist for Alphabet.
quotes.for: Hassabis: 2024 Nobel laureate and Alphabet chief scientist.

quotes.text: London-based Isomorphic launched in 2021 and shared news of its first fundraise of $600 million in March 2025. To date, the company has raised at least $7.7 billion—all without ever disclosing a clinical program.
quotes.for: The $600 million first round in March 2025, and no disclosed clinical program.

quotes.text: launched today as a new biotechnology company dedicated to unraveling the deep biology of cellular rejuvenation programming
quotes.for: What Altos Labs does, in its own words: cellular rejuvenation, not AI drug discovery.

quotes.for: The $3 billion Altos Labs launched with in 2022.

title: Isomorphic Labs president says all drugs will be AI-designed as first trials near a year-end target

quotes.text: November 5, 2026
quotes.for: Publication date of the R&D World article.

quotes.text: At Davos on Jan. 20, Hassabis said Isomorphic expected its first clinical trials by the end of 2026, Reuters reported
quotes.for: The end-of-2026 target for first clinical trials.

quotes.text: In the Bloomberg interview, Jaderberg described its programs as “deep in pre-clinical development,” where researchers design molecules and test them in cells and animal models before advancing into human trials.
quotes.for: Jaderberg on the programs’ stage in November 2026.
